method: (1) Automated re-run: for every stored item whose stem shows runnable Python or an SQL query on a shown table, the code/query was re-executed from the stem text alone (text files rebuilt from the stem; tables parsed from the stem into sqlite3 with MySQL-style functions) and compared with the stored answer. (2) Manual review: random samples of generated items (5 per chapter, plus mock items) read against NCERT CS XII; code outputs, try/except traces, stack and postfix traces, network-case answers, SQL outputs and degree/cardinality items in the samples traced by hand.
fixes: statements that begin with code (len(), s[0], csv.reader() ...) are prefixed with 'In Python,' so Assertion-Reason options no longer show 'Len()' or 'Csv.reader()'
error-finding items always contain exactly 4 errors so the key (1/2 mark each) adds up to 2 marks
5-mark function items ask for two functions (2 + 3 marks)
function names in 'write a function' items match the task
fact-only engine families trimmed in code subtopics so output-prediction and coding items dominate chapters 1-4, 8-9
plural grammar in table items; stack pop functions print 'Stack Empty'
